title: What's new in v2.11.6
summary: Bring your UniFi InnerSpace floor plans onto the Signal Map, and edit your floor plan faster: change many walls at once, and move APs with a right-click.

steps.title: Import from InnerSpace
steps.listLabel: Bring your UniFi InnerSpace scans and floor plans onto the Signal Map
steps.body:
**Import** brings a building in from UniFi InnerSpace: a LiDAR scan, a floor plan drawn there, or a Design Center project imported into it, with its walls, windows, doors, floors, and APs.

Add it as a new building, or as new or replaced floors of one you already have, then drag, rotate, or **Snap to Building** to lay it down.

steps.title: Signal Map Toolbox
steps.listLabel: Edit your floor plan faster: change many walls at once, and move APs with a right-click
steps.body:
The **Signal Map** now has a toolbox under the zoom buttons: **Pan**, **Select**, **Draw Layout**, **Undo**, and AP placement.

With **Select**, drag a box over walls, then click one to change all their materials at once. **Right-click** an AP to **Move** or **Remove** it.
